description: CRUD operations for annotation JSON files in .graphcoder/annotations/. Slug-named files with canonical sorted-key JSON. Kind registry in annotation-kinds.json with auto-colour assignment. V1 to V2 migration via normalizeAnnotation.
label: Annotation Persistence

members.note: Generates UUID, writes {slug}.json with sortKeys canonical JSON.
Reads and deserialises a single annotation file.
Reads all .json files from the annotations directory.
Removes the annotation file from disk.
The full interface: id, version, shape, kind, status, label, description, members, geometry, author, timestamps, reasoning.
Reads the kind registry from annotation-kinds.json.
Registers a kind if absent. Deterministic colour from name hash.
Reconciles registry against kinds actually used in annotation files.
